title: Antisemitism allegations against Rams' Puka Nacua 'false and damaging,' lawyer says

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Antisemitism allegations against Rams' Puka Nacua 'false and damaging,' lawyer says
sources.description: Puka Nacua is accused of biting a woman and making an antisemitic comment. The Rams WR's lawyer acknowledged the allegations but said his client denies them.
